summary: Maintain SLO history declaration inputs from changed desired keys instead of reparsing every objective at every history cut

replay.detail: The recorder bootstraps current declarations once; subsequent committed desired changes update only their named declarations. A retained-journal gap rebuilds the input projection.

schema.detail: No persistent schema changes. The recorder owns its parsed declaration input projection.

rules.detail: Native measurement windows and history samples retain their real minute boundaries. Objective evaluation, breach handling and readiness evidence validation remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: History and API wire formats are unchanged. Adds slo_history_inputs declaration_full_reads and declarations_parsed work counters to the performance response.

downtime.detail: Normal restart; input state is rebuilt from authoritative declarations.

manual.detail: No manual migration. Repeated unchanged history cuts and unrelated claim commits perform zero declaration parsing; a changed declaration reparses only that key.

recovery.detail: Earlier binaries continue reading the same declarations and history files.
